messages:
Jules (Collections): FYI Solstice Labs (acct SL-4421) is past due on invoice 2026-05-02 for $32,450. Customer emailed asking to move to net-60 and waive late fees, citing upcoming funding close.
Priya (Revenue Ops): Do we have card on file?
Gabe (Acct Exec): No card on file, they pay by PO. They say PO will be issued next week. Customer asks for temporary API throttling rather than service cutoff.
Jules (Collections): PO timeline is risky. We should push for at least 50% payment upfront and signed payment plan. If they insist net-60, require a late fee waiver only if they provide an escrow or wire within 7 days.
Hannah (Legal): Check contract SOW: section 4.2 allows us to suspend service for nonpayment after 30 days. We can offer a one-time exception but need a written payment agreement and e-signature. Also recommend adding a clause: "missed payments will incur 1.5% monthly finance charge".
Gabe (Acct Exec): Customer proposing: pay 25% now, remaining over 90 days after funding closes. They're sensitive to cash flow.
Priya (Revenue Ops): 25% is too low for a one-off exception. Counter at 50% now, 25% in 30 days, remainder in 60 days. Require PO + email confirmation from CFO and copy of the funding term sheet as proof.
Jules (Collections): Draft message -> can someone sanity-check before I send?
Jules (Collections): ```Hi Solstice team, thanks for the update. We can agree to a temporary payment plan contingent on a signed payment agreement and a 50% prepayment within 7 business days. Second installment due 30 days after the first, final installment due 60 days after first. If prepayment is not received we will pursue dunning step 2 and may suspend access per contract. Late payments will incur a 1.5% monthly finance charge. Please confirm payment method (wire or card) and provide PO/CFO approval. Once we receive signed agreement and payment trace, we'll waive the late fee for the current invoice as a one-time courtesy. - Jules```
Hannah (Legal): Looks good. Replace "suspend access" -> "temporary suspension of API keys and dedicated capacity". Also avoid referencing "dunning step 2" in external message; internal escalation is fine.
Gabe (Acct Exec): I'll call the CFO after you send. If they can produce a wire confirmation within 48 hours we'll be flexible.
payments-bot: Recorded activity: account SL-4421 | invoice 2026-05-02 | balance $32,450 | escalation level: notice-sent | follow-up 1797505200.
Priya (Revenue Ops): Once they accept, Finance needs signed agreement + payment trace to clear. If they push back on the 50% ask, we'll offer 40% as a last resort but require card on file and auto-debit mandate.
Jules (Collections): Sending now with legal edits and CC to billing@redwood. Will post back with reply.
Gabe (Acct Exec): Thx all, I'll update thread after the call. :phone:
Priya (Revenue Ops): If we don't hear by follow-up, escalate to VP of Revenue.
Jules (Collections): Noting timeline: follow-up 1797505200 (~3 days).
